name: ramus v2.1.0
body:
# 2.1 - visualiser revamps

### New Features
- brand new "pulsar" visualiser. i spent loads of time and lots of music tweaking it to be super responsive and hypnotic to watch. I always loved visualisers, and i always loved the one that inspired this, and i think i've made it as good as it could be imo. give it a try!
- visualisers are now real time too. no more precompute. this means we've got em on iOS too. No android yet, sorry droiders. Soon maybe
- a "clear screen" mode that just showcases the visualiser, good for a second monitor or casting to a tv. it also has an optional kind of karaoke sing-along type lyrics display if the song you're listening to has timed lyrics.
- cast to other plex players such as plexamp or anything else that can accept plex casting. This might be because i am working on an apple TV app, maybe.

### Improvements
- Discovery crates are supported on desktop now
- background gradients are much smoother, no more banding at all as far as i can tell. even under worst possible case scenarios. just smooth all around
- vastly reduced battery usage on ios (all) and gpu usage on macos 26

### Fixes
- fixed a bug that was inflating local play counts (didnt touch your scrobbles or server play counts)
- fixed macOS title bar double click to maximise

### Available Binaries:

- **macOS (Universal)** - `*_universal.dmg` (works on Intel + Apple Silicon)
- **Linux (x86_64)** - `*_amd64.AppImage` / `*_amd64.deb` / `*.x86_64.rpm`
- **Linux (arm64)** - `*_aarch64.AppImage` / `*_arm64.deb` / `*.aarch64.rpm`
- **Windows** - `*_x64-setup.exe` (NSIS) or `*_x64_en-US.msi` (MSI).
- **Android** - `.apk` (sideload).
- **iOS (iPhone)** - `*_ios-adhoc.ipa` (sideload)

### Installation note:
These builds are **unsigned**, so you'll get a warning the first time you open the app:

- **macOS**: right-click the app > Open, then if it tells you it's damaged (thanks MacOS), go to System Settings > Privacy & Security > Scroll Down > Run Anyway. Or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/ramus.app` from your terminal to clear the quarantine flag.
- **Windows**: SmartScreen will show "Unknown publisher" - click "More info" > "Run anyway".
- **Android**: enable "Install unknown apps" for your file manager / browser, then tap the .apk.
- **iOS (iPhone Only)**: sideload however you like, or use sidestore source `https://1337raspberry.github.io/ramus.json` to grab this automatically.

Feedback very welcome.

name: v2.0.0
body:
# 2.0

#### Worked on so much since the last release I decided a 2.0 was appropriate here. A lot of the core look and feel and navigation and just...everything has been made better. If you tried ramus before and found it to be a little weird and esoteric, maybe give it another try :)

#### I'm still using this app every single day, all day, and i'm constantly working on making it better, even if i'm the only person that ever uses it. Hopefully somebody else can enjoy it as much as I do. Even if it is still a very niche proposition.

### New Features
- A new "Lists" hub that holds everything related to playlists, crates, fliters, etc.
- Discovery Crates. Generated and stored to your Plex Server, but features a whole bunch of stuff plex cant do natively. Includes cascading genre selection (so Metal = `Metal` + `All child genres`, not just anything tagged "Metal"), and you can use the popularity data plex already gives us, to listen to for example, "Top Rated Unplayed Tracks in `<Genre and all child genres>`. Dive into the best rated stuff you already have in your collection you've never listened to, that kinda thing. I've found some new favourites with it already, its pretty neat.
- Plex Collections support
- Plex Playlist Support. Browse, create, add tracks, drag to reorder, rename, delete. Smart playlists are supported too (to the extent that makes sense for this app). I also removed and reworked the "Bookmarks" feature and turned it into a Smart Filter instead, which makes more sense.
- Tentative iPad / Landscape / iPhone Duo support.
- Quick shortcuts on mobile. Long hold on Lists to shuffle play all your favourites. Long hold on genres button to go to settings.
- Mobile Suggestion view has a new album length filter. Going for a 30 minute run? Find a 30~ minute album. Got 75 minutes to kill before your next meeting? Find a 75~ minute album.
- Search completely redesigned and made far less esoteric and far more sensible. You can now search for stuff the way you'd expect and receive normal results like artists
- Support for rich metadata for genre info (think short description + long description, and clickably hyperlinks to other genres and example artists). Currently not really useful for anything and it doesn't ship with any data, but should somewhere like RYM ever launch their API where we can source that from, will be absolutely killer. Like a little mini genre wiki that you can interact with inside the app that ties directly into your own library. I tested it with a dummy data set and its extremely compelling and cool to use.

### Improvements
- Queue persistence. Keeps where you were when you closed the app. If you want. Turn it off in settings if you'd prefer.
- Much smarter transcoding logic and session lifetime and network resiliency stuff. I had a bunch of issues with some dodgy wifi and cell service on a long train journey and i got lots of good data for stuff that needed fixed. It's now a lot better! I've since been purposefully stress testing it and using it when my phone has the worst possible signal or in the worst position situations, and its as reliable in those situations as any other plex music app imho.
- Up Next - you can now rearrange and remove tracks. Much better performance with massive playlist queues.
- Mobile Now-Playing screen is now way prettier. Balances better across screen sizes, looks better, responds better, makes more sense, just plain better.
- Background colour logic has been rewritten and it results in less generic brown washed out backgrounds when all colours just get summed up and look ugly. Stuff now reflects the art more naturally and looks pretty.
- Better visibility on syncing progress. In-app toasts now when it is happening.
- Lyrics redesigned on mobile. Far easier to read and just much prettier imo

### Bug-Fixes - too many to mention them all but some standout ones
- tracks now resume at the playhead instead of at 0:00 during network switchover
- tracks no longer get truncated after the app is force-quit mid download
- no longer able to get stuck on a plex.tv relay (slow network), and will go back on direct routes if/when they become available
- better reliability for ios and android lockscreen integration
- two identical tracks in a row on android no longer crashes the app
- search doesnt disappear sometimes on ios anymore
- release builds were actually unoptimised "debug" builds. release builds should be smaller and faster now after build time optimization
- plex hosted lyrics now load properly (lrc/txt sidecar files)

### Available Binaries:

- **macOS (Universal)** - `*_universal.dmg` (works on Intel + Apple Silicon)
- **Linux (x86_64)** - `*_amd64.AppImage` / `*_amd64.deb` / `*.x86_64.rpm`
- **Linux (arm64)** - `*_aarch64.AppImage` / `*_arm64.deb` / `*.aarch64.rpm`
- **Windows** - `*_x64-setup.exe` (NSIS) or `*_x64_en-US.msi` (MSI).
- **Android** - `.apk` (sideload).
- **iOS (iPhone)** - `*_ios-adhoc.ipa` (sideload)

### Installation note:
These builds are **unsigned**, so you'll get a warning the first time you open the app:

- **macOS**: right-click the app > Open, then if it tells you it's damaged (thanks MacOS), go to System Settings > Privacy & Security > Scroll Down > Run Anyway. Or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/ramus.app` from your terminal to clear the quarantine flag.
- **Windows**: SmartScreen will show "Unknown publisher" - click "More info" > "Run anyway".
- **Android**: enable "Install unknown apps" for your file manager / browser, then tap the .apk.
- **iOS (iPhone Only)**: sideload however you like, or use sidestore source `https://1337raspberry.github.io/ramus.json` to grab this automatically.

Feedback very welcome.

name: v1.0.2
body:
### Improvements
- Made the shuffle-all-favourites function feel more random. It's actually less random technically but it spaces stuff out intentionally so it feels more random to our silly lizard pattern matching brains
- setup prefetch logic for waveform seeking and album art as well so the live playing experience continues even if you hit a dead spot in cellular coverage or whatever
- removed the "pin" lyrics toggle and just made that the default behaviour. it was kind of stupid in the first place imo and should have always been that way tbh
- save lyric file sidecars by default so if you listen to an album, then go back and listen to it again, it's not going to try and grab the same lyrics for no reason when it already had em right there smh
- made the "clear all filters" button more obvious, i kept getting annoyed at how hard it was to find sometimes and i put it there so if i cant find it what hope does anybody else have.

### Bug-Fixes
- fixed a visual and parsing bug with genre titles that had "/" in them
- adjusted timeouts for lrclib to be a little more generous and also made it more clear if a lyrics isnt fetched why. not just "no lyrics" even when the server timed out or like, youre offline or whatever.
- fixed a scroll bug on the mobile album grid that made scrolling up the list after coming back out from the detail view be really janky
- fixed the settings panel on mobile being all crammed on the tabs, and some of the panels having auto overflow leading to horizontal scrolling just because 1px flowed past the gutter
- reduced the up next playlist view just greedily grabbing every single bit of album art at first load. Its all 72x72 tiny little thumbs so its actually not a huge deal imo, but added some concurrency limiting so we dont hammer for no reason. only really affects the "shuffle all favourites" functionality and favs dont change much in a persons library presumably, so once this is hit once anyway, they're all cached anyway so its nbd imo

### Available Binaries:

- **macOS (Universal)** - `*_universal.dmg` (works on Intel + Apple Silicon)
